name: Epic Hellstroke Great Axe
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Hellstroke Great Axe

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Cold Iron
effects.tooltip: Cold Iron : This iron mined deep underground, known for its effectiveness against fey creatures, is forged at a lower temperature to preserve its delicate properties. When combined with Good damage types, Cold Iron weapons are able to overcome the damage reduction of most Demons like Fire Reavers or Flesh Renders . See Monster DR and weaknesses for specifics.

effects.name: Doublestrike
effects.tooltip: Doublestrike 11% : Passive: 11% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)

effects.name: Incite
effects.tooltip: Incite +91 : +91% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage

effects.name: Keen
effects.tooltip: Keen : Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification .

effects.name: Maiming
effects.tooltip: Maiming : This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +4d8 damage.

flavor_text: A fearsome polearm that resembles the cruel implements orthon warriors use to rend their enemies. It occasionally allows the user to attack twice consecutively, much like an orthon.

source.raw: Epic version of Hellstroke Great Axe
